**Coaching Note:**
When your opponent's pieces are clustered together, look for checks that force the king to move and leave defenders vulnerable. After Rxc2+, White's king must move, leaving the queen and rook undefended on the same file. You win major material by force. Watch for how a forcing move (check) can expose tactical weaknesses—always follow your checks to their conclusion.
